# A single GPU: months between issues, maybe.
# A 512-1024 GPU cluster, running for weeks:
#
#   hundreds of GPUs x hundreds of NICs x many nodes
#   each with a nonzero failure rate
#   + preemption, driver crashes, NCCL errors
#
# -> at least ONE failure during the run is likely,
#    not an edge case.
caption: Without checkpointing, a day-12 failure on a 3-week run loses all 12 days.

code:
# Checkpoint too rarely -> more progress lost on failure
# Checkpoint too often  -> I/O overhead slows every run
#
# Fix: asynchronous checkpointing
#   write to fast local/host memory first
#   flush to durable storage in the background
#   -> training isn't blocked on the slow write
caption: Async checkpointing decouples safety from the full I/O cost on the critical path.
